items:
if [ -z "$DETECTED_PROFILE" ]; then
	for EACH_PROFILE in ".profile" ".bashrc" ".bash_profile" ".zprofile" ".zshrc"
	do
		if DETECTED_PROFILE="$(nvm_try_profile "${ZDOTDIR:-${HOME}}/${EACH_PROFILE}")"; then
			break
		fi
	done
fi

if nvm_has git; then
	install_nvm_from_git
elif nvm_has_executable curl || nvm_has_executable wget; then
	install_nvm_as_script || exit $?
else
	nvm_echo >&2 'You need git, curl, or wget to install nvm'
	exit 1
fi

builder() {
	if is_musl && is_x86_64; then
		cargo install cross
		echo "cross"
	else
		echo "cargo"
	fi
}

for NVM_SCRIPT_FILE in nvm-exec bash_completion nvm.sh
do
	command mv -f "$INSTALL_DIR/$NVM_SCRIPT_FILE.download" "$INSTALL_DIR/$NVM_SCRIPT_FILE" || {
		nvm_echo >&2 "Failed to move '$INSTALL_DIR/$NVM_SCRIPT_FILE.download' into place"
		return 3
	}
done

for REF in "${PREV_REF}" "${END_REF}"; do
	git rev-parse --quiet --verify "${REF}^{commit}" >/dev/null || {
		# shellcheck disable=SC2016
		printf >&2 'release-notes: `%s` is not a valid ref.\n' "${REF}"
		exit 1
	}
done

if [ "${COMP_WORDS[i]}" == "-f" ]; then
	f="${word}"
else
	if [ "${word:0:1}" == "/" ]; then
		d="${word}"
	else
		d="${d}/${word}"
	fi
fi

if [ "${COMP_WORDS[i]}" == "--config-file" ]; then
	f="${word}"
else
	if [ "${word:0:1}" == "/" ]; then
		d="${word}"
	else
		d="${d}/${word}"
	fi
fi

if [[ "${prefix}" != "${cur}" ]]; then
	local mloaders=""
	for l in ${loaders}; do
		if ! [[ "${prefix}," =~ .*,$l,.* || "${prefix}," =~ ^$l,.* ]]; then
			mloaders="${mloaders} $l"
		fi
	done
	toks=( ${toks[@]-} $(compgen -P "${prefix}," -W "${mloaders}" -- ${cur_} ) )
fi

if ${BASH_OR_ZSH} && ! nvm_profile_has_line "${NVM_PROFILE}" '$NVM_DIR/bash_completion'; then
	nvm_echo "=> Appending bash_completion source string to $NVM_PROFILE"
	if [ -n "$(command tail -c 1 "$NVM_PROFILE")" ]; then
		nvm_echo >> "$NVM_PROFILE"
	fi
	command printf '%b' "$COMPLETION_STR" >> "$NVM_PROFILE"
else
	nvm_echo "=> bash_completion source string already in ${NVM_PROFILE}"
fi

if [ -n "${NVM_RELEASE_NOTES_SKIP_PRS-}" ]; then
	LOOKUP_PRS=0
elif ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
	# shellcheck disable=SC2016
	printf >&2 'release-notes: `gh` is not available; PR references will be omitted.\n'
	LOOKUP_PRS=0
fi

nvm_install_dir() {
	if [ -n "$NVM_DIR" ]; then
		printf %s "${NVM_DIR}"
	else
		nvm_default_install_dir
	fi
}

case "${SUBJECT}" in
	*' '*) # not a bump commit, just a subject that starts with a version
		printf >&2 'release-notes: no category prefix, filing under Misc: %s\n' "${SUBJECT}"
		KEY='misc' TEXT="${SUBJECT}"
	;;
	*) continue ;; # a version bump commit
esac

main() {
	if [ "$1" = "--check" ]; then
		check_name
	else
		rename_test
	fi
}

nvm_make_alias() {
	# prevent local alias creation, and store arguments
	echo "${1}|${2}" >> "$ALIAS_PATH"
	if [ "${1}" != 'lts/*' ]; then
		echo "${1#lts/}" >> "$LTS_NAMES_PATH"
	fi
}

if $LIBUV_RELEASE; then
	"$AUTOCONF" -o /dev/null m4/libuv-check-versions.m4
	echo "
AC_PREREQ($autoconf_version)
AC_INIT([libuv-release-check], [0.0])
AM_INIT_AUTOMAKE([$automake_version])
LT_PREREQ($libtoolize_version)
AC_OUTPUT
" > m4/libuv-check-versions.m4
fi

if [ -z "${NVM_REMOTE_NAME}" ]; then
	NVM_REMOTE_NAME='nvm-origin'
	local NVM_REMOTE_SUFFIX
	NVM_REMOTE_SUFFIX=0
	while command git --git-dir="${INSTALL_DIR}/.git" config --get "remote.${NVM_REMOTE_NAME}.url" >/dev/null; do
		NVM_REMOTE_SUFFIX=$((NVM_REMOTE_SUFFIX + 1))
		NVM_REMOTE_NAME="nvm-origin-${NVM_REMOTE_SUFFIX}"
	done
	command git --git-dir="${INSTALL_DIR}/.git" remote add "${NVM_REMOTE_NAME}" "${NVM_GIT_SOURCE}" || return 2
fi

if ! nvm_profile_has_line "${NVM_PROFILE}" '/nvm.sh'; then
	nvm_echo "=> Appending nvm source string to $NVM_PROFILE"
	command printf '%b' "${SOURCE_STR}" >> "$NVM_PROFILE"
else
	nvm_echo "=> nvm source string already in ${NVM_PROFILE}"
fi

if [ -z "${REPO_SLUG}" ]; then
	ORIGIN_URL="$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null)" || ORIGIN_URL=''
	case "${ORIGIN_URL}" in
		*github.com[:/]*) REPO_SLUG="$(printf '%s' "${ORIGIN_URL}" | sed 's#^.*github\.com[:/]##;s#\.git$##')" ;;
	esac
fi

if [ "$(find_name | wc -l)" != "0" ]; then
	echo "Still some files to treat:"
	find_name
else
	echo "Done"
fi

check_name() {
	if [ "$(find_name | wc -l)" != "0" ]; then
		printf '%s\n\n' "The following filenames contain unwanted characters:"
		find_name
		printf '\n%s\n%s\n' "Please run ./rename_test.sh" "If the problem persist, please open an issue."
		exit 1
	else
		echo "Ok"
	fi
}

if git cat-file -e "$UPSTREAM:packages/typeorm/package.json" 2>/dev/null; then
	:
else
	die "'$UPSTREAM' does not contain packages/typeorm; fetch the latest master"
fi

if [ "${1:-dev}" = "release" ]; then
	export LIBUV_RELEASE=true
else
	export LIBUV_RELEASE=false
fi

if test -n "$missing"; then
	echo "missing from the FreeRTOS build:"
	echo "$missing"
	exit 1
fi

if declare -fF _compopt_o_filenames > /dev/null; then
	_compopt_o_filenames
else
	compopt -o filenames
fi

if [ -f "$INSTALL_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then
	nvm_echo "=> nvm is already installed in $INSTALL_DIR, trying to update the script"
else
	nvm_echo "=> Downloading nvm as script to '$INSTALL_DIR'"
fi

if [ -n "${HOME-}" ]; then
	case "${PROFILE_INSTALL_DIR}/" in
		"${HOME}"/*) PROFILE_INSTALL_DIR="\$HOME${PROFILE_INSTALL_DIR#"${HOME}"}" ;;
	esac
fi

for job in "$NVM_SH_PID" "$NVM_EXEC_PID" "$NVM_BASH_COMPLETION_PID"
do
	wait "$job" || NVM_DOWNLOAD_STATUS=$?
done

if git cat-file -e "$MERGE_BASE:packages/typeorm/package.json" 2>/dev/null; then
	echo "Nothing to do: this branch is already based on the packages/ layout."
	exit 0
fi

if [ $? != 0 ]; then
	echo "Run 'pip install autobahntestsuite', maybe with 'sudo'."
	exit 1
fi

if [ $? != 0 ]; then
	echo "Run 'brew install jq'"
	exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f target/fuzzingserver-actual.txt ]; then
	echo "File not found. Did you run the Autobahn test script?"
	exit 1
fi

if [ $aclocal_version != $automake_version ]; then
	echo "FATAL: aclocal version appears not to be from the same as automake"
	exit 1
fi

if [ "${PROFILE-}" = '/dev/null' ]; then
	# the user has specifically requested NOT to have nvm touch their profile
	return
fi

if [ -n "${PROFILE}" ] && [ -f "${PROFILE}" ]; then
	nvm_echo "${PROFILE}"
	return
fi

if ! nvm_has git; then
	nvm_echo >&2 "You need git to install nvm"
	exit 1
fi

if ! nvm_has_executable curl && ! nvm_has_executable wget; then
	nvm_echo >&2 "You need curl or wget to install nvm"
	exit 1
fi

if ${BASH_OR_ZSH} && [ -z "${NVM_PROFILE-}" ] ; then
	nvm_echo "=> Please also append the following lines to the correct file if you are using bash/zsh shell:"
	command printf "${COMPLETION_STR}"
fi

if [ -z "${NEW_VERSION}" ]; then
	printf >&2 'Usage: %s <new-version> [<prev-ref>] [<end-ref>]\n' "$0"
	exit 2
fi

nvm_install_node() {
	local NODE_VERSION_LOCAL
	NODE_VERSION_LOCAL="$(nvm_node_version)"

	if [ -z "$NODE_VERSION_LOCAL" ]; then
		return 0
	fi

	nvm_echo "=> Installing Node.js version $NODE_VERSION_LOCAL"
	nvm install "$NODE_VERSION_LOCAL"
	local CURRENT_NVM_NODE

	CURRENT_NVM_NODE="$(nvm_version current)"
	if [ "$(nvm_version "$NODE_VERSION_LOCAL")" = "$CURRENT_NVM_NODE" ]; then
		nvm_echo "=> Node.js version $NODE_VERSION_LOCAL has been successfully installed"
	else
		nvm_echo >&2 "Failed to install Node.js $NODE_VERSION_LOCAL"
	fi
}
